'''Eric de Pablos Solà''' (born 8 March 1999) is an Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)#Full-back|right-back]] for [[FC Rànger's]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{LaPreferente}}</ref>

==Career==
De Pablos made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 3 June 2021, coming on as a substitute in the 73rd minute for [[Moisés San Nicolás]] in a [[Exhibition game|friendly]] match against the [[Republic of Ireland national football team|Republic of Ireland]]. The home match finished as a 4–1 loss.<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=31500 |title=Eric de Pablos |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=3 June 2021}}</ref>
